Native loop corpus passes expected-output tests; full original compiler comparison not performed.

typed_capabilities.records: Nominal records, nested fields, value assignment; cyclic type definitions pending.
typed_capabilities.routines: Typed user functions/procedures, value and var parameters, recursion, Result and Exit; overloads, nested routines, defaults and user generics pending.

GetDir/GetCurrentDir, ChDir/SetCurrentDir with per-execution cwd, MkDir/CreateDir, empty-directory RmDir/RemoveDir, DeleteFile, RenameFile/RenameDirectory and lexical ChangeFileNameExtension. Host cwd is unchanged. CP1251 default is now native on all platforms.
typed_capabilities.text_files: Text/TextFile default objects, shared reference assignment, Assign/AssignFile, Reset/Rewrite/Append with optional filename, Close/CloseFile, Flush, Read/Readln, Write/Writeln, Eof/Eoln/SeekEof/SeekEoln, OpenRead/OpenWrite/OpenAppend and typed Read*/Readln* functions. User routine/local/unit shadowing retained; unsupported generic routines reject arguments explicitly rather than ignoring them. Malformed syntax, arity/type/nil/alias/lambda/static metadata/limits and package examples covered; generic user declarations and other explicit generic library APIs pending.
typed_capabilities.typed_list_copy_to: Native List.CopyTo(array), CopyTo(array,destinationIndex), CopyTo(sourceIndex,array,destinationIndex,count), exact closed element types and rank-one arrays. Existing destination cells/record field var aliases retained, records copied and nested references shared; source Count/Capacity/enumerator version unchanged. typed_capabilities.native_reference_class_fields: Named typed-field class declarations and native no-argument construction, exact closed field types before execution, predeclared class identities supporting mutual references and class/record/container reference cycles without allowing recursive value records. Native nil/default references, zero numeric and nil string/reference fields including nested record CLR-style defaults; reference assignment/equality/parameter/container semantics while records retain value copies. Writable object fields from computed receivers and nested record var aliases, const reference cannot be replaced while object state remains mutable. Typed field access verification and class metadata validation independent of ordered by-value dependencies, construction header/field quotas, execution-owned weak tracking and no-allocation cycle breaking on success/errors. Class/List/callable/reference/alias/nil/metadata/resource corpus; inheritance, user generic classes, cross-unit private access and object formatting remain pending.
typed_capabilities.native_instance_class_methods: Class procedure/function bodies with explicit result types, closed signatures registered before binding bodies, direct and implicit Self calls, recursive/cross-method calls and exact receiver identity. Self is a read-only reference parameter while fields remain mutable; local/parameter versus member versus global name priority retained. Existing var/out/const/default/params handling and VM user_call frames reused, up to fifteen explicit parameters. Method lambdas capture Self and can call other methods after outer return. Routine owner metadata is verified as a closed class with by-value first receiver parameter; VM freezes receiver before arguments and checks nil after all arguments before body, including constant/no-field methods. Shared VM resources/call limits, parameter/type/owner/corrupt metadata/evaluation-order tests and portable example. Bound method values, method/constructor overloads, inheritance and cross-unit member access pending.
typed_capabilities.native_class_properties: Closed typed nonindexed class properties with optional read/write field or method accessors. Exact field/property types and getter/self/result or setter/self/value/unit signatures checked before execution, duplicate names rejected. Field accessors lower to verified owner-tagged synthetic routines; method accessors reuse exact routines, no runtime name lookup. Frozen receiver and RHS before setter nil check, no getter during assignment; distinct bilingual read-only/write-only diagnostics. Record copies preserve existing target field cells/var aliases, reference arrays/objects retain identity and mutable contents, callable properties use typed value calls. Indexed properties, expression accessors and remaining class features pending.
typed_capabilities.native_class_constructors: One typed constructor Create or unnamed constructor declaration with begin/end body, exact owner and hidden Self. new C(arguments) binds existing default/params/ref argument semantics before execution; explicit/default arguments run before object/header/zero-field allocation, then constructor procedure body runs and returns Self, including early Exit. Class variables/default(C)/array elements remain nil without construction. Dedicated verified object-producing construct_user call, unit constructor body and no normal/delegate/default-construction bypass; exact owner/receiver metadata and shared VM limits. Methods/properties and Self-capturing lambdas work in bodies, cycle cleanup retained on errors. Evaluation/allocation/body ordering, defaults/params/var/recursion/Exit/nil defaults/corrupt targets/callable bypass corpus and portable example. Constructor overloads, inheritance/chaining and remaining class features pending.
typed_capabilities.native_external_class_methods: Class method/constructor predeclarations and qualified external begin/end implementations, exact static signature/parameter-name/mode/result checking with resolved type aliases, inherited declaration defaults and omitted implementation headers. All bodies merge into original routine identities before binding, so mutual calls, properties and captured Self preserve the existing VM semantics without runtime lookup. Missing/duplicate/unmatched bodies and repeated defaults produce bilingual errors before output. public/private/protected/internal field and routine metadata retained and verified, default class access private. Current single-source module follows source compiler module-wide private visibility; custom source units, cross-unit access, inheritance and overloads pending. Native regression corpus and portable example cover bodies, defaults, ref/params/const, aliases, properties, lambdas and corrupted visibility metadata.
typed_capabilities.native_class_field_initializers: Explicitly typed class fields with one initializer/name, statically checked before any execution. Private owner-tagged initializer routine with separate readonly Self scope evaluates fields in declaration order per object, after constructor arguments/allocation and before constructor locals/body. Constructor parameter shadowing excluded; fields/globals/methods/properties and Self-capturing lambdas supported. Fresh arrays/List/nested objects, shared VM quotas/call depth/cancellation and cleanup on initializer failure. Synthetic no-argument constructor for classes without a declared one, verified construction-bypass prevention; nil variables/default(C)/reference array elements remain inert. Order, isolation, captures, recursive limits, invalid types and metadata corpus plus portable example. Inferred field types, records/static fields, inheritance and remaining class features pending.
typed_capabilities.native_short_routine_bodies: Typed function := expression, procedure/constructor := statement, unnamed short constructors, global/class/qualified external forms. Parser lowers to existing return/statement HIR; no alternate evaluator or runtime type inference. Existing declared signatures, omitted external headers, params/ref/defaults, recursion, closures with Self, field initialization and shared VM resources retained. Type errors precede output; nil and expression failures retain bilingual source positions. Regression corpus, unchanged original short_fun.pas and portable example. Result type inference without an explicit declaration, static/virtual methods and remaining language features pending.
typed_capabilities.unicode_bom_text_file_decoding: Shared native Unicode BOM detection for ReadAllText, ReadAllLines, Text/OpenRead/Reset and FilesOperations.ReadFileToEnd. UTF-8 BOM stripping plus UTF-16/32 LE/BE; longer UTF-32LE signature wins its UTF-16LE prefix as StreamReader, including leading-NUL ambiguity. Only initial BOM removed, NUL/noncharacters retained, valid surrogate pairs preserved; UTF-16 isolated surrogates/trailing byte and UTF-32 invalid scalars/incomplete final unit use U+FFFD. Previous byte/string limits and file diagnostics retained. Independent golden bytes, exhaustive scalar corpus in both byte orders, malformed-unit cases and public API/portable tests. Unmarked input uses mutable DefaultEncoding (CP1251 initially); UTF8 uses modern replacement. Full streaming/sharing remains pending; explicit Encoding overloads are tracked separately.
typed_capabilities.windows1251_characters: Native ChrWindows(byte):char and OrdWindows(char):byte plus ChrAnsi/OrdAnsi aliases, global/qualified calls and exact typed library values/callbacks. All 256 decoder bytes including 0x98 control, 640 published encoding mappings with best-fit approximations and question-mark fallback for unmapped single UTF-16 units, including isolated surrogates. Reproducible hash/count-checked table generator and exhaustive independent Windows reference fixtures for 256 decoded bytes and 65536 separately encoded code units; native golden/source/type/callable/resource diagnostics and portable example. Runtime depends only on C++ and static tables. String codecs and explicit whole-text file overloads are tracked separately; mutable DefaultEncoding is implemented; remaining scalar conversions pending.

Factories by integer/name and UTF8/Unicode/BigEndianUnicode/UTF32/ASCII, CodePage, GetPreamble, GetBytes string/char-array, GetString/GetChars byte-array. Cached per-execution identities, nil defaults and abstract construction rejection, source name shadowing and argument order. Unicode LE/BE, ASCII and CP1251 codecs, modern maximal-subpart UTF8 replacement, strict internal mode, raw BOM as data versus file preamble detection, 1 MiB guards. EN/RU encoding errors and source positions; independent codec corpus, corrupt bytecode tests, Qt highlighting and portable example. ReadLines/Text.Lines, derived Encoding constructors, fallback objects, offset/count overloads and other code pages pending. Legacy Framework UTF8 invalid-surrogate replacement intentionally differs from modern selected behavior.
typed_capabilities.mutable_default_and_text_encodings: Native mutable DefaultEncoding global initialized to cached Encoding.GetEncoding(1251) before user initializers, ordinary typed references/var/lambda/global shadowing and bytecode slot verification. Per-execution FileContext obtains the current setting for implicit whole-text/lines/Text/FilesOperations calls; each open Text writer retains its own codec. Explicit OpenRead/OpenWrite/OpenAppend, global Reset/Rewrite/Append with optional path and Encoding, and member Encoding overloads use closed verified signatures. Deferred output preamble including empty files, no duplicate mark on nonempty append, replacement codecs, retained Rewrite buffer/encoding and ignored replacement argument on existing writer. Source-reviewed native CP1251 bytes, default-change/BOM/snapshot/nil/error-order tests and portable example. CP1251 availability is deterministic across native platforms; source provider-dependent fallback is not required. ReadLines/Text.Lines, derived codec constructors, streaming/dualmode and full external file sharing pending.
typed_capabilities.typed_file_line_io: Typed ReadAllLines and WriteAllLines optional Encoding overloads, qualified PABCSystem names, exact rank-one string array types, nil string as empty line, CR/LF/CRLF splitting and no extra terminal line. WriteLines accepts exact string sequences and native array/List adapters, opens writer before source iteration, snapshots DefaultEncoding/explicit codec and streams completed lines with host newline. Late callback failure retains prior output through writer cleanup; List enumeration versions and source effects retained. Shared Text codecs/preamble emission, file/open-object limits, bounded work/cancellation, native bytecode encoding operand range/type/stack verification and bilingual source diagnostics. Codec/BOM/empty/nil/shadowing/partial-output/corrupt-metadata regression corpus and portable example. ReadLines, Text.Lines, full streaming input and external sharing/disposal parity remain pending; earlier documentation listing ReadLines as implemented has been corrected.
typed_capabilities.native_sequence_cursor_lifetime: Native sequence cursor leases own active traversal independently of retained enumerable prototypes. Last lease release disposes actual nested cursors and owned traversal state on helper early return/errors and routine exit. Explicit verified sequence_dispose at lazy foreach normal/break exit; continues retain their active cursor. Idempotent disposal, bounded actual-child graph cleanup without traversing source prototypes, preserved numeric range descriptors for restart and no cleanup callbacks/allocations. Regression tests retain native child state to verify disposal despite aliases, restart prototypes and disposed range cursors, reject malformed cleanup bytecode and exercise nested break/return; portable restart checks.
